findings.passage: “I am very respectful and mindful of people’s Second Amendment rights and the right to bear arms. We’re not trying to infringe upon that at all,” she said.
findings.note: Quoted by the AJC in an interview held 2026-10-02, published 2026-10-05, on gun restrictions and the Second Amendment.

findings.passage: “You can balance both. We can protect people’s Second Amendment rights. We can be mindful of the Constitution, but we can also push for responsible gun ownership and gun access.”
findings.note: Quoted by the AJC in the same interview; she says gun safeguards and Second Amendment rights can both be kept.

findings.passage: She endorsed strengthening red-flag laws, which allow courts to temporarily restrict gun access for people deemed a danger to themselves or others, and closing the “gun show loophole” that allows speedier firearm purchases.
findings.note: This sentence is the AJC reporter's summary of what she endorsed in the interview, not her direct quote. Saved as a report of her stated position, from the outlet.

findings.motion: Signed U.S. Conference of Mayors letter urging the Senate to pass two House-passed gun safety bills (as Atlanta mayor)
findings.note: As Atlanta mayor she added her signature on a Thursday to a letter from 214 mayors asking the Senate to reconvene and pass two House-approved background-check bills. The AJC page text gives no calendar date; 2019-08-08 is the date other outlets report for the letter.
